question: What effect on age-related death results from abstaining from food for a day?
premises: Non-eating for a day is prescribed
The practice leads to going beyond or overcoming it
inference: By abstaining from food for a day, one will overcome age-related death
uncertainties: gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ may mean will go to death or will overcome death; context suggests overcoming
plain_english: By not eating for a day, one will overcome death due to aging.
